metadata.title: Email Campaign Platform SSPP - Medicine Advancement Communications
metadata.remarks: Instance SSPP for Medicine Advancement Communications. This deployment instantiates the Email Campaign Platform SSPP Template with a documented deviation related to institutional branding templates.

import-profile.remarks: Imports the Email Campaign Platform SSPP Template and its normative trust, consent, opt-out, and regulatory requirements.

system-characteristics.system-name: Email Campaign Platform - Medicine Advancement Communications
system-characteristics.system-description: Institutional email campaign platform instance supporting Medicine Advancement Communications outreach.

props.name: branding-template-source
props.remarks: This instance does not use centrally managed branding templates.

components.title: Email Campaign Platform (Envoke)
components.remarks: Envoke provides opt-out enforcement, suppression lists, and delivery audit logs.

components.title: Institutional Identity (Entra ID)
components.remarks: Roles are mapped to HRIS-backed Entra ID groups.

components.title: Local Branding Templates
components.description: Custom email templates developed and maintained locally by Medicine Advancement.
components.remarks: Templates are reviewed by local communications leadership but do not currently inherit from centrally approved branding templates.

components.title: Medicine Advancement CRM
components.remarks: Authoritative source of consent and audience eligibility under data-exchange agreement.

roles.title: Branding / Communications Approver
roles.remarks: Mapped to MED Faculty Communications leadership group.

control-implementation.remarks: All baseline controls are inherited except where noted in findings. Deviations are managed through governance findings and POA&M.
